Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the Planner incorrectly reasoned that because Don Hahn was 54 years old in 2009 and Fernando di Leo was 44 years old in 1976, Don Hahn must have been born earlier. This logic is flawed because it compares the ages of two directors at different points in time (1976 vs 2009) rather than comparing their actual birth years. The correct comparison is 1955 (Don Hahn) vs 1932 (Fernando di Leo), meaning Fernando di Leo was born earlier. The Planner failed to perform the direct subtraction of birth years from the current year or simply compare the birth years directly, leading to the wrong conclusion.
